subject: TREE BREAK (not mine): render_encoder.inc:2543/2548 atomics on 'TeguBuffer **'
body: Host compile of the whole frontend fails since ~02:07: render_encoder.inc tegu_color_write_table_buffer (new sRGB colour-table helper): '__atomic_load_n(&table,...)' / '__atomic_store_n(&table,...)' on 'static TeguBuffer *table' => 'address argument to atomic operation must be a pointer to integer, pointer or supported floating point type (TeguBuffer ** invalid)' (clang 23 refuses ObjC object pointers in atomics). Fix: keep 'static uintptr_t table' and cast ((TeguBuffer *)table) / (uintptr_t)obj. This also fails integration_tests render_cache (path_blit contract) and anything that compiles the frontend. My own edits (api_*.inc, indirect-draw bodies at render_encoder.inc ~3870-3885) are unaffected.
